{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Found'' your ''slave camp'' and ''freed'' the prisoners last night, I did. ''Deceived'' you, Count Dooku has.|Yoda|<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />}}
A '''camp''' for [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] was maintained by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
[[File:TatooineB1scamp.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] deactivated by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] at the slave camp]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] set up this [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] [[Prison/Legends|camp]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to incarcerate [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. Consequently, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] deceived a [[Unidentified Jawa clan|Jawa clan]] into believing that their fellow Jawas were being made slaves by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This treachery allowed him to buy Republic [[Starship/Legends|ship]] parts from the Jawas, which were used to retrofit [[Warship/Legends|warships]] of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]]. In exchange, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] promised them that, given time, the Republic would be driven from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and their people would be freed from Republic oppression. As a result of this trade, the Separatists won several battles in the Outer Rim and Republic losses increased dramatically in this region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />

Concerned by the fact that the Separatists appeared to be using Republic weapons against their own ships, [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] followed a trail of evidence leading to Tatooine. Suspecting a Jawa clan to be responsible for recovering the debris and selling them to Dooku, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] went on a [[Mission to Tatooine (Yoda)|mission]] to Tatooine in order to investigate. There, disguised as the Jawa [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Yoda/Legends|Nemb]] of [[Adoy Clan]], Yoda infiltrated the suspected clan. That night, he found the Separatist slave camp, which was guarded by at least one [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]], and freed its [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], including [[Fodani]]. The next day, during a visit of Count Dooku on Tatooine, Fodani revealed to his clan that it was actually the Separatist leader who had enslaved the Jawas. Yoda then engaged Dooku in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], while the Jawas helped him by firing their [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blasters]] at the Sith Lord. Outnumbered, Dooku fled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] aboard his [[Count Dooku's solar sailer/Legends|his]] [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]].<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />

Following the event, the Jawas put an end to their trade with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Also, to thank the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] for freeing their people, the Jawas gave him schematics of Separatist weapons and ships, thus enabling the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] to defend its ships in the Outer Rim.<ref name="Yoda Uncovered" />
